description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mellawagedara, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510068
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 33, Block 02) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and encumbrances. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
